evidence.claim: Devon&Devon ha sede a Firenze, disegna e produce prodotti di lusso per il bagno e soluzioni su misura per la casa, con produzione soprattutto in Toscana.
evidence.quote: Devon&Devon is an Italian company based in Florence that designs and produces luxury products for the bathroom and custom solutions with a distinctive sartorial feel for the home || Most of the production is manufactured in Tuscany, the cradle of millenary manufacturing knowledge. The other small production units are located in Italy and England || Architects, interior designers and contractors can benefit from an exclusive free consultancy service with the Devon&Devon experts
